MapProperties.MapDescription: Mario Kart / GlideOn inspired arcade racing proof-of-concept in Realm.
MapProperties.Author: RealmArcade
MapProperties.LoadingBodyText: Steer with Right-Click or ground clicks. Press Q for Turbo Boost, W to use collected Mario Kart Power-Ups, E to Drift-Boost corners, and R to Brake or recover onto the track.
MapProperties.HowToPlayObjective: Complete 3 laps around the circuit before rival racers!

Units.Name: Item Crystal
Units.Description: Mystery item box! Drive through to roll a random power-up.

Units.Name: Spike Trap
Units.Description: Track hazard! Causes rival racers who hit it to spin out.

Units.Name: Arcane Shell
Units.Description: Launched shell projectile that knocks out rivals on impact.

Abilities.Name: Bola de fuego
Abilities.Description: [X] Bola de fuego — Daño 50 en área (radio 4)

Abilities.Name: Turbo Boost
Abilities.Description: [Q] Fires your chariot thrusters forward for 1.8s.

Abilities.Name: Use Power-Up
Abilities.Description: [W] Activates your held Mario Kart item (Mushroom, Green Shell, Red Shell, Spike Trap, Lightning, or Star).

Abilities.Name: Drift Boost
Abilities.Description: [E] Tightens steering through corners for 1.4s and releases a Mini-Turbo surge.

Abilities.Name: Brake / Recover
Abilities.Description: [R] Slams the brakes to take sharp turns cleanly or snap back if stuck.

Abilities.Name: Steer Left Stop
Abilities.Description: Stop steering chariot to the left.

Abilities.Name: Steer Right Stop
Abilities.Description: Stop steering chariot to the right.
